summary: Both edits carry the full intent with nothing missing or added, and placement is sensible. The only problems are a few requirements stated on more than one entry.

findings.detail: busy-times and user-availability carry the identical note "Carry the optional title through busy-time data to the troubleshooter, overlay week view, and conflicting-slot hover card."

"Request titles only for overlay mode using the logged-in user's own credentials" and "Keep other availability requests on the ordinary path" appear on calendar-manager and again on schedule-management (fresh) / schedules-api (chain).
The edge note "Fetch the enabled social-login providers when the continue modal opens" repeats the same sentence already in the booker-ui note.

A small doubt only: the overlay title request with the user-ID check goes on schedule-management, whose files are schedule CRUD handlers. Its availability _router is the nearest fit in the fresh graph, which has no calendarOverlay handler, so no clearly better component exists.
